mapper.select: SELECT FROM public.user_info WHERE user_name = #{userName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND is_delete = 0

SELECT id, uid, user_name, password, email, is_vip, nike_name, avatar, type, role_id, status, descript, sex, create_time, create_user, update_user, update_time, is_delete, version, salt FROM public.user_info WHERE email = #{email,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND is_delete = 0 and type=1

SELECT u.id, u.uid, u.user_name, u.nike_name, u.email, u.avatar, u.status, u.type, u.is_vip, u.vip_expire_time, u.role_id, u.create_time, u.sex, u.descript, r.name AS role_name, r.level FROM public.user_info u LEFT JOIN public.role r ON u.role_id = r.id WHERE u.is_delete = 0 AND (u.nike_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.uid LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY u.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, uid, user_name, password, email, is_vip, nike_name, avatar, type, role_id, status, descript, sex, create_time, create_user, update_user, update_time, is_delete, version, salt FROM public.user_info WHERE user_name = #{username} and type=1

SELECT id, uid, user_name, password, email, is_vip, nike_name, avatar, type, role_id, status, descript, sex, create_time, create_user, update_user, update_time, is_delete, version, salt FROM public.user_info WHERE id = #{id,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND is_delete = 0 AND type = 0

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.user_info WHERE is_delete = 0) AS total_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.user_info WHERE is_delete = 0 AND is_vip = true) AS vip_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.user_info WHERE is_delete = 0 AND type = 1) AS admin_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.user_info WHERE is_delete = 0 AND create_time::date = CURRENT_DATE) AS today_new_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.user_info WHERE is_delete = 0 AND create_time::date = CURRENT_DATE - 1) AS yesterday_new_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM public.operation_log WHERE is_delete = 0 AND operation_time::date = CURRENT_DATE) AS today_active_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM public.operation_log WHERE is_delete = 0 AND operation_time::date = CURRENT_DATE - 1) AS yesterday_active_count

SELECT u.uid, u.nike_name, u.avatar, u.descript, u.sex, u.is_vip, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.user_follow f1 WHERE f1.user_id = u.id AND f1.is_delete = 0) AS follow_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.user_follow f1 WHERE f1.follow_user_id = u.id AND f1.is_delete = 0) AS fans_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ue.like_count), 0) FROM public.video_info uv INNER JOIN public.video_episode ue ON ue.video_id = uv.id AND ue.is_delete = 0 WHERE uv.user_id = u.id AND uv.is_delete = 0) AS total_like_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ue.play_count), 0) FROM public.video_info uv INNER JOIN public.video_episode ue ON ue.video_id = uv.id AND ue.is_delete = 0 WHERE uv.user_id = u.id AND uv.is_delete = 0) AS total_play_count FROM public.user_info u WHERE u.is_delete = 0
AND (u.nike_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.uid LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY ${orderColumn} DESC
ORDER BY fans_count DESC
